class.name: VirtualCamera2D
class.brief_description: A place for the viewport's [Camera2D] to be: following a target or framing a group.
class.description: Add virtual cameras to a scene beside an ordinary [Camera2D]. Each frame, every virtual camera works out where it should be, and the viewport's current [Camera2D] takes the position and [member zoom] of the live one: the one with the highest [member priority]. When the live camera changes, the real camera blends from where it was over the new camera's [member blend_time]. The real camera's position smoothing is turned off while it's driven: use [member follow_damping] instead. Its limits still apply.

method.name: is_live
method.description: Whether the real camera is following this one.

method.name: shake
method.description: Shakes the view by up to a few pixels on screen at a [param strength] of [code]1.0[/code], fading over [param duration] seconds. A weaker shake doesn't cut short a stronger one.

method.name: snap
method.description: Puts the camera where it should be at once on the next frame, without [member follow_damping].

members.member: How the blend to this camera eases, with [member blend_transition].
How long the real camera takes to move over when this camera becomes live. [code]0[/code] cuts.
The curve of the blend to this camera, as a [Tween]'s.
How slowly it catches up with where it should be, in seconds: about how long it takes to cover most of the way. [code]0[/code] keeps up exactly.
Where it sits from its target, or from the middle of its group.
With [constant FOLLOW_GROUP], the nodes it keeps in view.
With [constant FOLLOW_GROUP], the space kept round the group, in pixels on screen.

The live camera is the one with the highest priority in its viewport, among those that can process (see [member Node.process_mode]). On a tie, the one that entered the tree or changed priority last wins.
The real camera's zoom while this one is live. With [constant FOLLOW_GROUP], the closest it zooms in: it zooms out from there as the group spreads.

signal.name: live_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the camera becomes live, or stops being live.

constants.constant: Keeps every node in [member follow_targets] in view, zooming out as they spread.
